title: Add notes to this folder's memory
run:
set -euo pipefail
notes=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
  line=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/^[-* ]*//')
  [ -n "$line" ] && notes+=("$line")
done <<< {{notes}}
if [ ${#notes[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "nothing new to remember"; exit 0; fi
{{swarm}} memory add -project {{project}} -about {{about}} "${notes[@]}"
